brand.name: Sobremesa
brand.meaning: In Spain, sobremesa is the long, unhurried talk at the table after a meal, when nobody is in a hurry to leave. We plan trips at that pace.
brand.description: Slow, regional travel in Spain: food, small towns, rail journeys and festivals, planned for curious adults who want to travel like locals.

contact.hours: Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 14:00 and 16:00 to 19:00 (Spanish time)
